summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-Enum with the eleven members; botocore/args.py imports it as EPRBuiltins, makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint_config, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Verification: test_args.py, test_regions.py and test_client.py pass (414 passed). The full unit suite has 11 failures that are identical on the untouched tree, so they predate this change. No commit made. Open points: the helper calls the bridge's private _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint; SDK::Endpoint is None (key present) when absent.
